critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py now 8625 lines (phase 6 added ~310). Phase 6 block self-contained: welcome packet, door check-in, spotlight archive, prayer board should be extracted into backend/members/{welcome,checkin,spotlight_archive,prayers}.py routers; the member portal file is now a maintenance risk.

_welcome_html at line 8324 uses strftime('%B %-d, %Y') which is a GNU libc extension - works on Linux containers but silently breaks on Windows/BSD dev machines. Use '%B %d, %Y' with manual lstrip('0') or dateutil for portability.

_send_welcome swallows send_email errors and returns False, but admin_welcome_resend only returns 400 with no hint on *why* (e.g., not active vs email provider rejected). Consider surfacing a short reason string for staff debugging.

members_prayers endpoint fetches 300 docs then rebuilds every doc server-side per request without pagination; a year of active use can easily exceed 300. Suggest cursor pagination (sort by created_at desc + 'before=' param) and move answered posts to a separate archive view.

_prayer_view hides anonymous author's picture only (returns '') but still returns author_id in nowhere — good — however the raw db docs include 'author_id' and 'praying' arrays which _prayer_view does not strip from mine=True payloads (fine) but the pray/encourage endpoints also don't rate-limit by user; a single IP shares a 10/5m bucket with threads/replies, so a legitimate member chatting and praying from the same IP can be throttled quickly across unrelated features. Consider per-feature buckets or at least a per-user bucket.

admin_checkin() rebuilds the sheet via a separate GET for every scan - UI calls POST then re-GETs the full roster. For large rosters (>500) this is O(n) each tap. The POST response could echo updated counts to avoid the extra GET.

admin_checkin_finish marks everyone not yet in attendance as absent, including members registered after the meeting date (member_since > meeting.date). Consider restricting to members whose member_since <= meeting.date so brand-new sisters don't get spurious absences & fines.

members_spotlights returns at most 300 published rows - fine for years but no pagination; also no dedupe guard - if two staff publish spotlights for the same month quickly, both can slip past because the pre-publish check is not inside a transaction (TOCTOU). Low risk, acceptable.
